items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Our band was Pick Pick Brass Band. And that day- Arnold was from La Place... Sometimes we'd meet together

ctx.x: What did they call the brass band? A brass, huh? What was the name of the band?

Oh, Arnold. Our band was Pick Pick Brass Band. And that day- Arnold was from La Place, Arnold from La Place, and Pick Pick was a resort. Sometimes we'd meet together, we'd meet together, and try to help buck. Yeah, every Sunday they'd meet, you know, each one, we'd be kicking up dust, you know, didn't have to- Yeah, praying good musicians out there, they were. Yeah, oh man, praying good. The old days now. They've been to the young fellas, the general fellas, huh? But I pray to them. My grandson, he's good, he's…
What's his name? Joseph Valentine. Joseph Valentine.
